copy_script:
@echo off
if exist C:\xwn604-kit goto fail
mkdir C:\xwn604-kit
copy D:\FIXTURE.DLL C:\xwn604-kit\FIXTURE.DLL
if errorlevel 1 goto fail
copy D:\SUBJECT.EXE C:\xwn604-kit\SUBJECT.EXE
if errorlevel 1 goto fail
copy D:\TRACE.EXE C:\xwn604-kit\TRACE.EXE
if errorlevel 1 goto fail
copy D:\RUN604.EXE C:\xwn604-kit\RUN604.EXE
if errorlevel 1 goto fail
attrib -R C:\xwn604-kit\*.*
echo XWN604 READY - EJECT CD BEFORE RUNNING
exit
:fail
echo COPY FAILED
pause
